text:
maria: Heads up — we've been getting a spike of pages overnight for 'gpu_node_down' across multiple AZs. ~40 pages in 3h, many duplicates when nodes reboot during maintenance windows. Thinking we should move low-sev instances to ticketing and tweak grouping.

deepak: Saw it too. Most of those were from the same autoscale group flapping after kubelet update. They all fired separate alerts because node name differs. :facepalm:

sarah: Can we group by cluster+asg label? Alertmanager grouping_key={cluster,asg} should collapse them.

leo: Agree. Also threshold needs work — current rule fires on node kubelet not ready for 30s. Change to 5m and require count > 3 nodes in same asg? That would reduce noise.

maria: Proposed approach:
- change PromQL to require >3 nodes down OR cluster-level rate-of-change > 10%,
- set severity=page only for 'impacting' (count>3 OR region-wide),
- send severity=warning to ticket queue (ops@) otherwise,
- add mute window for scheduled maintenance (via silence or label match).

deepak: Could we use alertmanager group_by: ['cluster','asg','severity'] and group_wait/group_interval tweaks? Also use `repeat_interval` longer for warning alerts?

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance detected for cluster 'eu-west-1-prod' 02:00-04:00 UTC, created silence id: s-abc123

sarah: Example PromQL I'd try:
```
sum by (cluster,asg) (kube_node_status_condition{condition='Ready',status='false'}) > 3
or
changes(kube_node_status_condition{condition='Ready',status='false'}[5m]) / count by (cluster,asg) (kube_node_status_condition[5m]) > 0.1
```

maria: Alertmanager snippet for routing:
```
route:
  group_by: ['cluster','asg','severity']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 4h
routes:
  - matchers: ['severity="page"']
    receiver: 'pagerduty'
  - matchers: ['severity="warning"']
    receiver: 'ticketing-system'
```
I'll open a PR to test on canary cluster.

leo: Please add a test harness run and a Prometheus rule dry-run. Also add a dashboard panel showing grouped alert counts so SREs can watch impact during rollout.

sarah: We'll also hook this to SLO burn rate alerts — if error budget burn exceeds 5% in 1h escalate to page regardless of count.

maria: I'll target a canary rollout tomorrow 01:00 UTC (use non-prod namespace). tagging @oncall to be aware.

oncall-bot: @maria noted. Oncall window monitored.

deepak: :thumbsup: fine with plan. Make sure to document muting via tickets and maintainers list.
